hooks.statusMessage: Installing workspace deps in worktree (pnpm install)…
hooks.command: wt="$(jq -r '.tool_response.path // .tool_response.worktreePath // .tool_response.cwd // .worktree_path // .cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$wt" ] || wt="$PWD"; root="$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; case "$root" in */.claude/worktrees/*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$root/pnpm-workspace.yaml" ] || exit 0; [ -d "$root/node_modules/.pnpm" ] && exit 0; cd "$root" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline >/dev/null
